name: proppi-agent-desktop
description: Optional Proppi MCP connection for supported desktop clients; requires account authentication.

interface.shortDescription: Desktop MCP connection to your Proppi account
interface.longDescription: Optional authenticated connection to Proppi's remote MCP service. Workspace imports of this plugin are desktop only. Requires a compatible client's sign-in flow and your Proppi account permissions. Install Proppi Agent separately for its planning and evidence skills.
